scope: Proposition 7.3 (Comparability and the calibrated initial slope) of the manuscript “The low-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick free-energy limiting law” (preprints/The-low-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-free-energy-limiting-law-September-24-2026/The-low-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-free-energy-limiting-law-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 217 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4acb0e456988f38e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 53. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every optimizer in (C5), uniformly, r(v) ≍ v (wc ≤ v ≤ 1), sup cu≤v≤Cu |r(v) − q(v)| = o(u) (C7) for each fixed 0 < c < C (fixed numeric multiples, not the removal profile).
